deadline.intake: September 2027 entry, 2nd round for international degree students (1st round closes 19 Nov 2026)

tuition.note: Two semesters at 35,700 TWD tuition each (Liberal Arts, Social Sciences, Law; other colleges 35,980 per semester); 2026/27 figures, for reference only

requirement.text: Applicants with a high school diploma can apply for undergraduate programmes and must submit a graduation certificate and full transcript; for English-taught programmes proof of English proficiency equivalent to CEFR B2 is required.
